user.title: Add a CAN interface
user.description: Pick the CAN interface to add. Interfaces that are already added are not listed.

can.title: CAN interface {port}
can.description: Driver: {driver}. Every node on the bus must use the same bitrate.

data_description.listen_only: Never acknowledge or send: watch an existing bus without touching it.
data_description.restart_ms: 0 = stay in bus-off until the entry is reloaded.
data_description.filters: Only receive these IDs, comma separated: 123 (11-bit), 18FF50E5 (29-bit), 7E0/7F0 (ID/mask). Empty = everything.
data_description.max_events_per_sec: Frames beyond this rate are counted but do not update entities or fire events.

error.bad_filter: Invalid filter. Use hex IDs, optionally ID/MASK, separated by commas.
Invalid filter. Use hex IDs, optionally ID/MASK, separated by commas.

send.name: Send CAN frame
send.description: Send one CAN / CAN FD frame, optionally waiting for a reply ID.

config_entry_id.name: Interface
config_entry_id.description: The CAN interface to send on.

data.name: Data
data.description: Hex bytes: up to 8 (classic) or 64 (CAN FD).

extended.name: Extended ID
extended.description: Force a 29-bit ID (default: decided by the ID length).

fd.name: CAN FD
fd.description: Send as a CAN FD frame (CAN FD must be on for the interface).

brs.name: Bit rate switch
brs.description: CAN FD: send the data phase at the data bitrate.

wait_id.name: Reply ID
wait_id.description: Return the first received frame with this ID (empty = any frame).

not_loaded.message: {entry} is not a loaded WOOW CAN interface.

tx_queue_full.message: {name}: the CAN transmit queue is full. Usually nothing on the bus acknowledges the frames: check wiring, termination and bitrate.
